usage.project_application: 作为 L10 interaction-ready 层的候选 verifier，避免语义正确但物理不可用。
usage.modifications: 将 agent 模型限制为预注册用户/设备几何假设；任何缺失谓词返回 UNKNOWN，不由 VLM 自行补全。
usage.expected_effect: 把功能目标错误进一步定位为语义 grounding 失败或物理 predicate 失败。

evaluation.setup: 未执行；最小证伪实验：冻结候选功能区，仅加入五项 predicate verifier；在每次只破坏一个条件的最小对照集上测故障层识别与 false-ready。
evaluation.claim_boundary: SceneTeract 的 3D/VLM 证据不能直接代表真实用户；BlindAssist 未复现，predicate 通过也不是动作结果、用户收益或安全证据。

evidence.summary: Primary source reviewed for mechanism and evidence boundary; no BlindAssist reproduction is implied.

history.change: Added from the user-provided directed literature review as a candidate only; no route authority or experimental result was created.
